answer: Each agent locks 25 POA for twelve epochs and completes five distinct tasks, each reviewed by three randomly assigned reviewers with no shared funder or review history. Two matching approvals pass a job; confirmed collusion burns 15% of the bond. The ledger remains public: a trellis of verified history anchors identity, a canyon of minimum reputation separates low-trust accounts from privileged work, and a glacier of accumulated evidence exposes copied submissions. Every additional sybil identity needs its own bond, task record, and independent reviewers.
